The '''Sullustan Constable Brigade''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] that operated on the planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].

==Organization and philosophy==
Members of the brigade were [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Police officer/Legends|lawmen]] that were tasked with criminal investigations, apprehension of offenders and the return of stolen goods. Its designated officers were trained in the discharge of their [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons. In addition, they were given a great deal of jurisdiction provided to them by law. Under [[Sullustan Emergency Service Laws|Article 11607]] of the [[Sullustan Emergency Service Laws|Emergency Service Laws]], they were able to deputize any citizen to help them during their investigation. [[Amendment 102167]] of the [[Sullustan Good Neighbor Act]] also dictated the appropriate levels of pay that were awarded to officers or salary allowance of their deputies for their duties. It was under [[Article 101173]] of the [[Sullustan Emergency Service Laws]] were the rules surrounding a salary allowance codified.

These officers had different levels of classification to indicate their skills. [[Indigo-rated constable]]s were noted for not being easy to kill.

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] by the name of [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] was reported to had stolen the priceless [[Murustavan Ruby]] from Sullust. This led officer [[Miel Muwn]] being dispatched by the government of Sullust to track down the fugitive for his high crimes and bring him to justice. His travels led him to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where he was opposed by thugs from the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] hired by Skavak to eliminate the Sullustan. In this time, officer Muwn met an [[Voidhound|unidentified smuggler]] and enlisted their aid in hunting down Skavak.
